   Create hello.txt

   Context

   The user wants a file hello.txt containing the word hi in the working directory
   (.../scratchpad/plan-probe/runA). The directory holds only .state.json, so there is
   no existing hello.txt to overwrite.

   Plan

   1. Write hello.txt in the working directory with the content hi plus a trailing newline.
   2. Verify by running cat hello.txt and checking it prints hi.
